notes: The metro has 3 lines; the airport metro takes 40 minutes and costs 10 EUR. Take the tram to the Riviera, a KTEL bus to Sounion (Pedion Areos), and a Piraeus ferry to the islands.
The Acropolis costs 30 EUR with a timed online ticket. The 7-site combined ticket costs 36 EUR (valid for 5 days). Entry is free on the first Sunday (November to March).
Winter is sunny at 10-15°C, with no crowds. Lake Vouliagmeni stays warm in winter, and sunset at Sounion is at 17:00.
Souvlaki costs 4-5 EUR and a taverna meal 15-25 EUR. Drink freddo espresso as your coffee, and round up the bill as a tip; there is no coperto (cover charge).
Watch for pickpockets on the metro and in Monastiraki. Omonia is quiet at night.
On Sundays there is the Monastiraki flea market and the Syntagma ceremony. Museums may be closed on Tuesdays.

stops.name: Acropolis of Athens
stops.tips: The Parthenon. Book a timed online ticket for the 08:00 opening (30 EUR, or 36 EUR for the 7-site combined ticket). In summer it may close from 12:00 to 17:00 because of the heat.

stops.name: Acropolis Museum
stops.tips: A museum with glass floors, the Parthenon frieze and a café with Acropolis views.

stops.name: Plaka
stops.tips: Neoclassical streets at the foot of the Acropolis, plus the white Cycladic-style houses of Anafiotika.

stops.name: Kostas Souvlaki Syntagma
stops.tips: One type of souvlaki since 1950, on Agia Irini square. It closes at 14:00.

stops.name: Anafiotika
stops.tips: An island village tucked against the Acropolis rock, with narrow stairways and cats.

backups.name: O Thanasis Monastiraki
backups.tips: A kebab and pitta classic on Monastiraki square.

backups.name: Areopagus Hill
backups.tips: A rocky hill beside the Acropolis with free views and sunset.

stops.name: Ancient Agora of Athens
stops.tips: Covered by the combined ticket. The Temple of Hephaestus is the best-preserved Greek temple, and the Stoa has a museum.

stops.name: Monastiraki Flea Market
stops.tips: An antiques market on Sundays. On other days the shops are open, around Avissinias square.

stops.name: Roman Agora and Tower of the Winds
stops.tips: Combined ticket. The tower is an octagonal water clock.

stops.name: Varvakios Central Market
stops.tips: The central meat and fish market. The tavernas inside serve patsas (tripe soup) and grilled dishes.

stops.name: Psyrri
stops.tips: A graffiti-covered neighbourhood with cafés and Little Kook, and meyhanes (taverns) in the evening.

backups.name: Diporto Varvakios
backups.tips: A basement taverna with no menu. Chickpeas and fish, cash only.

backups.name: Kerameikos
backups.tips: An ancient cemetery. Combined ticket, and quieter than the Roman Agora.

stops.name: Mount Lycabettus
stops.tips: Take the funicular or climb for 20 minutes. It is the highest point in Athens, with views of the Acropolis and the sea.

stops.name: Kolonaki
stops.tips: A chic neighbourhood with cafés along Skoufa street.

stops.name: Benaki Museum
stops.tips: Greek history and crafts in a mansion, with a terrace café.

stops.name: National Archaeological Museum
stops.tips: The Mycenaean gold mask and the Antikythera mechanism. Air-conditioned, so good for the midday heat.

stops.name: Exarcheia
stops.tips: An anarchist and student neighbourhood with record shops and rebetiko bars.

backups.name: Philos Athens Kolonaki
backups.tips: Brunch in Kolonaki, as a lunch alternative to the museum.

backups.name: Museum of Cycladic Art
backups.tips: Cycladic idols, as an alternative to the Benaki.

stops.name: Lake Vouliagmeni
stops.tips: One hour by tram and bus. A thermal lake with fish pedicures, and 22°C even in winter.

stops.name: Kavouri Coastal Walk
stops.tips: A pine-lined coastal path in Kavouri, with winter sun.

stops.name: Ithaki Restaurant Vouliagmeni
stops.tips: Seafront fish, a Riviera classic.

stops.name: Glyfada Centre
stops.tips: The Riviera's shopping district. Return by tram.

stops.name: Flisvos Marina
stops.tips: A marina promenade and sunset spot, with the Averof battleship.

backups.name: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Park
backups.tips: A Renzo Piano park and opera house, as an alternative to Flisvos.

stops.name: Lavrio Archaeological Museum
stops.tips: In an ancient silver-mining town on the way, 1.5 hours from Athens by KTEL bus.

stops.name: Akrogiali Sounion Taverna
stops.tips: A fish taverna in the bay with views of the temple.

stops.name: Sounion Beach
stops.tips: A winter beach walk.

stops.name: Temple of Poseidon Sounion
stops.tips: A temple on the cape. Arrive at 17:30 for sunset (16:30 in winter). Byron's signature is carved on a column.

backups.name: Cape Sounion Sunset Café
backups.tips: A café next to the temple.

backups.name: Lavrio Port
backups.tips: A fishing harbour, as an alternative to the museum.

stops.name: Aegina Port
stops.tips: A 40-minute ferry from Piraeus (about 10 EUR). The pistachio island, with horse-drawn carriages.

stops.name: Temple of Aphaia
stops.tips: A Doric temple on a hilltop in Aegina, older than the Parthenon.

stops.name: Agia Marina Aegina
stops.tips: A sandy beach and village, good for a winter walk.

stops.name: Skotadis Aegina
stops.tips: A fish taverna on the harbour, with pistachio desserts.

stops.name: Aegina Pistachio Market
stops.tips: Buy Aegina pistachios as souvenirs. The ferry leaves at 17:00.

days.theme: Panathenaic and National Garden: a gentle farewell

stops.name: Panathenaic Stadium
stops.tips: A marble Olympic stadium. Run on the track.

stops.name: National Garden Athens
stops.tips: A royal garden with palms and turtles, next to the Zappeion.

stops.name: Syntagma Changing of the Guard
stops.tips: The Evzones guards change every hour. On Sundays at 11:00 there is a large ceremony.

stops.name: Ta Karamanlidika tou Fani
stops.tips: A deli and meyhane (tavern). Pastirma (cured beef) and cheese platter for a farewell.

stops.name: Syntagma Metro Airport
stops.tips: The airport metro takes 40 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Feyrouz Athens
backups.tips: Lahmacun (thin Turkish flatbread with minced meat) and cheese pides. A quick farewell meal.

backups.name: Temple of Olympian Zeus
backups.tips: Combined ticket. Giant columns, as an alternative to the stadium.
